Olivia M.: Quick heads-up — Sam asked to shift desks + reduce in-office days starting next week due to anxiety and it's affecting their on-call performance. Prefer to keep details confidential, what are the next steps?

Tara (People Ops): Thanks, Olivia. We can handle this confidentially. Please don't post medical details in-channel. If Sam is comfortable with an ADA accommodation, we should start the intake so we can log protections and put temporary supports in place. I'll DM the intake form link.

Olivia M.: Sam is fine with the accommodation process. Wants a quieter desk and 2 days remote per week. I'm worried about current oncall incidents — don't want this to turn into a performance thing. Any guidance?

Tara (People Ops): Accommodation != discipline. We will separate accommodation requests from performance actions unless there's an immediate safety/security issue. For now we can: quieter desk assignment (e.g., `desk-quiet-3B`), 2 remote days, and a 60-day check-in cadence. Also suggest an oncall swap for next Tue night. I'll file the confidential ticket and DM the form.

PeopleOpsBot: Created confidential ticket #PO-2026-447 for Sam. Intake form pushed to Sam via DM: https://redwood.internal/hr/forms/ada-intake — do not forward.

Sam L.: Thanks everyone. I'll fill out the intake form this afternoon. Quieter desk + 2 remote days sounds good. I can ask Priya to cover Tue night if Olivia confirms.

Olivia M.: I'll ask Priya for a one-off swap for Tue night. Sam — do you want me to schedule the first weekly check-in for Tue 10am?

Sam L.: Yes please, that works. Appreciate keeping this private :heart:

Tara (People Ops): I'll add the check-in to the ticket and share the accommodations checklist with you both. Olivia — please hold off on formal performance steps while we run the intake unless something urgent pops up. DM me if anything changes.
